name: EveryGyan · Google Sheets Articles to Gemini Drafts

nodes.name: Process One Topic at a Time

parameters.text:
=You are a senior publication editor, research strategist, and writer for EveryGyan (everygyan.com).

TOPIC: {{ $json.topic }}

Generate an authoritative, engaging ~500-word article formatted in clean Markdown, alongside all required metadata matching the EveryGyan CMS Create Article specifications.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. WORD COUNT: The article body must be approximately 500 words of substantive, high-value content.
2. MARKDOWN FORMATTING: Structure the content with:
   - ## Key Takeaways & Overview
   - ### Deep-Dive Insights & Analysis (with bullet points or comparison)
   - ### Real-World Examples or Practical Tips
   - ## Editorial Conclusion & Next Steps
3. CATEGORY: Map automatically to one of: "blog" (technology, editorial, lifestyle, business), "learning" (tutorials, step-by-step guides), or "travel" (destinations, itineraries).
4. STATUS: Must strictly be "draft".
5. UNSPASH COVER IMAGE: Provide a high-resolution, relevant Unsplash photo URL (e.g. technology/Apple/editorial photo).

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return ONLY a valid, raw JSON object. Do not wrap in markdown fences (```json) and do not include conversational greetings.

STRICT JSON SCHEMA:
{
  "title": "Engaging, high-converting article title",
  "slug": "url-friendly-lowercase-slug-using-hyphens",
  "excerpt": "A concise 1-2 sentence overview for cards and RSS (under 160 characters).",
  "category": "blog",
  "tags": ["Technology", "iOS", "Apple", "Updates"],
  "cover_image": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1510557880182-3d4d3cba35a5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80",
  "reading_time_minutes": 3,
  "content": "Full ~500-word Markdown article text...",
  "metadata": {
    "seo_title": "SEO title under 60 characters",
    "meta_description": "SEO description under 160 characters with strong call to action",
    "focus_keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2", "keyword3"],
    "citations": [
      { "title": "Official Apple Developer Documentation", "url": "https://developer.apple.com" },
      { "title": "TechCrunch Analysis", "url": "https://techcrunch.com" }
    ]
  }
}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  title: $json.post.title,
  slug: $json.post.slug,
  excerpt: $json.post.excerpt,
  content: $json.post.content,
  category: $json.post.category,
  tags: $json.post.tags,
  cover_image: $json.post.cover_image,
  reading_time_minutes: $json.post.reading_time_minutes,
  status: "draft",
  featured: false,
  metadata: $json.post.metadata
}) }}
